description.p: GrapeStrap is a desktop visual editor for building static Bootstrap 5 websites. Class-first styling, a Dreamweaver-faithful workflow with design, code, and split views over the same document, master templates with editable regions, and a plugin-first architecture. Your projects are plain folders of HTML on disk. No subscriptions, no telemetry.

screenshot.caption: Editing a Graphite starter project: file tree, canvas, and Custom CSS panel

description.p: Zone-aware drag placement with top-of-page insertion, element reordering from the right-click menu, starter page selection at project creation, New Page from starter layouts, full application menu wiring, Monaco code-editing assists, and fixes for code-view edits lost on tab switches and headers pasted above the body.
First public release: master templates, class-snapping drag-to-resize, starter templates, workspace layouts, live preview, crash recovery, and full UI localization.
